mock_data.title: A Sudden Decision
mock_data.passage:
'Have you any idea why Tom has left his job?' Fred asked Andy.

'Your guess is as good as mine,' replied Andy. 'I did hear that he was under a cloud when he left, but I think that was a rumour started by Jenny, one of his workmates, who doesn't like him. Tom has always been very hard-working and competent. I don't think he was dismissed. Whatever the reason, his resignation was a bolt from the blue. Everyone was surprised.'

Then Joan joined in the conversation, saying, 'He might have been bored. I would be climbing the walls if I had to sit in an office all day.'

'Quite the reverse,' replied Andy. 'Tom had a very interesting job and he loved it. He also liked his boss and the people he worked with.'

'I wonder if it is a case of cherchez la femme,' said Mary. 'My brother introduced Tom to an Australian girl called Mel a few weeks ago and they seemed to get on very well. I think my brother said that Tom and she had been out together quite a few times, but Mel is due to go back home fairly soon. Who knows? Perhaps Tom has decided on a life Down Under.'
mock_data.passageB1:
“Do you know why Tom left his job?” Fred asked Andy.

“I don’t know,” Andy answered. “I heard a story that he was in trouble, but I think Jenny started it. She works with him, but she doesn’t like him. Tom always worked hard and was good at his job. I don't think he lost his job. I don't know the reason, but his resignation was a big surprise to everyone.”

Then Joan joined the conversation. “Maybe he was bored,” she said. “I would be very unhappy if I had to sit in an office all day.”

“No, I don’t think so,” Andy said. “Tom had a very interesting job, and he enjoyed it. He also liked his boss and the people he worked with.”

“I wonder if it’s about a woman,” said Mary. “My brother introduced Tom to an Australian girl called Mel a few weeks ago, and they seemed happy together. My brother said that Tom and Mel went out together a few times, but Mel is going back home soon. Maybe Tom has decided to go to Australia!”
mock_data.passageB2:
"Any idea why Tom suddenly quit?" Fred asked Andy.

"I'm as clueless as you are," Andy responded. "I did hear a rumour that he was in disgrace before he left, but I reckon that was just Jenny, who's never really liked him, stirring things up. Tom's always been a dedicated and capable employee. I doubt he was fired. Whatever the reason, his resignation was a complete surprise out of the blue. Nobody saw it coming."

Joan joined the conversation, suggesting, "Maybe he was fed up. I'd be going crazy if I had to be stuck in an office all day."

"Quite the contrary," Andy replied. "Tom had a really stimulating job that he enjoyed. He also got on well with his boss and colleagues."

"I wonder if it's a case of 'follow the woman'," Mary mused. "My brother introduced Tom to an Australian girl, Mel, a few weeks back, and they seemed to hit it off. I think my brother mentioned they'd been on several dates, but Mel's due to return home soon. Who knows? Maybe Tom's decided to start a new life Down Under; he has always been open to new experiences."

'Do you have any inkling as to why Tom tendered his resignation?' Fred queried, directing his question to Andy.

'Your guess is as good as mine,' Andy responded. 'I did catch wind of a rumour suggesting he was in disgrace prior to his departure, though I suspect that was a fabrication orchestrated by Jenny, a less-than-admiring colleague. Tom has consistently demonstrated diligence and competence; therefore, I find it difficult to believe he was dismissed. Irrespective of the underlying reason, his resignation came as a complete bombshell. It took everyone completely by surprise.'

Joan then weighed in, postulating, 'Perhaps he was simply stifled. I, for one, would be driven to distraction if confined to an office environment day in, day out.'

'Quite the contrary,' Andy countered. 'Tom's role was, by all accounts, intellectually stimulating, and he derived genuine satisfaction from it. Furthermore, he enjoyed a positive rapport with both his supervisor and his team members.'

'I wonder if we should cherchez la femme,' Mary mused. 'My brother introduced Tom to an Australian woman, Mel, some weeks ago, and they appeared to hit it off. If I recall correctly, my brother mentioned that they had been seeing each other regularly; however, Mel is scheduled to return to Australia imminently. It's conceivable, isn't it, that Tom has decided on a whim to start a new life Down Under?' It's a far-fetched idea, but possible.

mock_data.translation:
'Tom nima uchun ishini tark etganini bilasizmi?' deb so'radi Fred Endidan.

'Mening taxminim sizning taxminingiz kabi,' deb javob berdi Endi. 'Men u ketganida shubhali vaziyatda bo'lganini eshitdim, ammo menimcha, bu uni yoqtirmaydigan ish do'stlaridan biri Jenni tomonidan tarqatilgan mish-mish edi. Tom har doim juda mehnatkash va malakali bo'lgan. Menimcha, u ishdan bo'shatilmagan. Sabab nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, uning iste'fosi kutilmagan hodisa edi. Hamma hayron bo'ldi.'

Keyin Joan suhbatga qo'shilib, 'U zerikkan bo'lishi mumkin. Agar men kun bo'yi ofisda o'tirishim kerak bo'lsa, men devorlarni tirnagan bo'lardim,' dedi.

'Aksincha,' deb javob berdi Endi. 'Tomning juda qiziqarli ishi bor edi va u buni yaxshi ko'rardi. U o'z boshlig'ini va ishlagan odamlarini ham yoqtirar edi.'

'Bu ayol izlash holatimi deb o'ylayman,' dedi Meri. 'Akam bir necha hafta oldin Tomni Mel ismli avstraliyalik qiz bilan tanishtirdi va ular juda yaxshi til topishgan ko'rinadi. Menimcha, akam Tom va u bir necha marta birga chiqishganini aytgan edi, ammo Mel tez orada uyiga qaytishi kerak. Kim biladi? Balki Tom Avstraliyada hayot kechirishga qaror qilgandir.'

mock_data.translationB1:
“Tom nima uchun ishdan ketganini bilasanmi?” – deb so'radi Fred Andidan.

“Bilmayman,” – deb javob berdi Andi. “U muammoga duch kelganligi haqida bir gap eshitdim, lekin menimcha, uni Jenni boshlagan. U u bilan birga ishlaydi, lekin uni yoqtirmaydi. Tom doim qattiq ishlagan va o'z ishini yaxshi bilgan. U ishdan haydalgan deb o'ylamayman. Sababini bilmayman, lekin uning iste'fosi hammaga katta kutilmagan hodisa bo'ldi.”

Keyin Joan suhbatga qo'shildi. “Balki unga zerikkandir,” – dedi u. “Agar men kun bo'yi ofisda o'tirishim kerak bo'lsa, juda baxtsiz bo'lardim.”

“Yo'q, menimcha, unday emas,” – dedi Andi. “Tomning juda qiziqarli ishi bor edi va u undan rohatlanardi. U, shuningdek, boshlig'ini va u bilan birga ishlaydigan odamlarni ham yaxshi ko'rardi.”

“Bu bir ayol haqida ekanligiga hayronman,” – dedi Meri. “Akam bir necha hafta oldin Tomni Mel ismli avstraliyalik qiz bilan tanishtirdi va ular bir-biriga yoqganga o'xshardi. Akamning aytishicha, Tom va Mel bir necha marta birga sayr qilishgan, lekin Mel tez orada uyiga qaytadi. Balki Tom Avstraliyaga borishga qaror qilgandir!”
mock_data.translationB2:
"Тom нега тўсатдан ишдан бўшади, ҳеч қандай тахмининг борми?" деб сўради Фред Эндидан.

"Мен ҳам сенчалик ҳеч нарса билмайман," деб жавоб берди Энди. "У кетишдан олдин шарманда бўлган, деган миш-мишни эшитдим, лекин бу шунчаки Женнининг гапи бўлса керак, у ҳеч қачон уни ёқтирмаган, гап тарқатиб юрган. Том доим фидойи ва қобилиятли ходим бўлган. Унинг ишдан ҳайдалганлигига шубҳам бор. Сабаби нима бўлишидан қатъи назар, унинг истеъфоси кутилмаганда содир бўлди. Ҳеч ким буни кутмаган эди."

Жоан суҳбатга қўшилиб, таклиф қилди: "Балки у зериккандир. Мен кун бўйи офисларга қамалиб ўтиришга мажбур бўлсам, ақлдан озардим."

"Аксинча," деб жавоб берди Энди. "Томнинг жуда қизиқарли иши бор эди ва ундан завқланар эди. У бошлиғи ва ҳамкасблари билан ҳам яхши муносабатда эди."

"Менимча, бу 'аёлни излаш' ҳолатига ўхшайди," деб мулоҳаза қилди Мэри. "Акам бир неча ҳафта олдин Том билан австралиялик қиз Мелни таништирди ва улар бир-бирларига жуда ёқиб қолишди. Акам улар бир неча бор учрашганини айтганди, лекин Мел тез орада уйига қайтиши керак. Ким билсин? Балки Том Австралияда янги ҳаёт бошлашга қарор қилгандир; у доим янги тажрибаларга очиқ бўлган."
mock_data.translationC1:
'Tomning iste'fosini topshirishiga nima sabab bo'lgani haqida biror taxmining bormi?' – deb so'radi Fred, savolini Andiga qaratib.

'Sening taxmining meniki bilan teng,' – deb javob berdi Andi. 'U ketishidan oldin obro'sizlangan degan mish-mishni eshitgandim, lekin bu Jennyning uyushtirgan uydirmasi deb o'ylayman, u unga unchalik ham xayrixoh bo'lmagan hamkasbi edi. Tom doimo tirishqoqlik va malaka ko'rsatib kelgan; shuning uchun uning ishdan bo'shatilganiga ishonish qiyin. Asosiy sababi nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, uning iste'fosi haqiqiy portlash bo'ldi. Bu hamma uchun kutilmagan hodisa bo'ldi.'

Keyin Joan o'z fikrini bildirdi va taxmin qildi: 'Balki u shunchaki siqilgandir. Men shaxsan, kun bo'yi ofis muhitida qamalib qolsam, aqldan ozishim aniq.'

'Aksincha,' – deb e'tiroz bildirdi Andi. 'Tomning roli har tomonlama intellektual jihatdan rag'batlantiruvchi edi va u bundan chinakam zavq olardi. Bundan tashqari, u o'z rahbari va jamoa a'zolari bilan ijobiy munosabatda bo'lgan.'

'Balki ayolni izlashimiz kerakdir,' – deb o'yladi Meri. 'Akam bir necha hafta oldin Tomni avstraliyalik Mel ismli ayol bilan tanishtirdi va ular kelishib ketganga o'xshardi. Agar eslasam, akam ularning muntazam ravishda uchrashib turganini aytgan edi; ammo, Mel tez orada Avstraliyaga qaytishi kerak. Tom bir zumda qaror qilib, Uzoq Janubda yangi hayot boshlashga qaror qilgan bo'lishi mumkin emasmi?' Bu asossiz fikr, lekin mumkin.
